facts.text: MCLockin is the LevyLab multichannel lock-in driver and talks to the instrument over ZMQ
The constructor takes the ZMQ server address and a channel configuration mapping each label to a lead number
Each configured label adds measurement parameters X, Y, R, Theta and Mean, named <label>_<measurement>
A measurement is read from the getResults dictionary under the key AI<lead>.Ref<ref>.<measurement>
get_idn reports vendor LevyLab, model MC Lock-in, serial None and firmware v2.15.4.4
The lock-in state parameter allows start, start sweep and stop
_set_state sends setState and _get_state returns the result of getStatus
The upstream sweep routine treats the getStatus result values idle and sweeping as its state machine
The ZMQInstrument constructor allows 5 s for a response by default
